fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Aramco Q3 net income of $31.2B exceeds analyst consensus of $28.7B, up from $28.6B YoY.
fields.summary_ko.1: Downstream adjusted EBIT surged 234% YoY to $10.3B, reflecting expanded refining margins and higher product prices.
fields.summary_ko.2: Base dividend held at Q3 $21.9B with a 3.5% YoY increase, demonstrating resilience despite geopolitical uncertainty.
